title: Tam Ryvora
description: Colossus mechanic Tam Ryvora dreamed of being a pilot. Tom befriended Kazuda Xiono, unaware that he was a Resistance spy. The truth shook her, and that broken trust drove her to the First Order. Tam became a TIE Fighter pilot. She later questioned her decision, and she would eventually connect with Kaz, paving the way for her return.
